examples.japanese: {歯|は}ブラシを{新|あたら}しいのに{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I replaced my toothbrush with a new one.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}に{歯|は}ブラシを{持|も}っていくのを{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to bring a toothbrush on the trip.

examples.japanese: {電動|でんどう}{歯|は}ブラシは{磨|みが}き{残|のこ}しが{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: Electric toothbrushes leave less residue after brushing.

notes:
{歯|は}ブラシ is a compound of {歯|は} (tooth) and ブラシ (brush). It's one of the essential daily hygiene items.

Related terms:
- {歯磨|はみが}き{粉|こ} (toothpaste)
- {電動|でんどう}{歯|は}ブラシ (electric toothbrush)
- {歯間|しかん}ブラシ (interdental brush)
- {糸|いと}ようじ / デンタルフロス (dental floss)

Usage note:
- {歯|は}を{磨|みが}く (brush one's teeth)
- {歯|は}ブラシで{磨|みが}く (brush with a toothbrush)
